# crosswork_roles (Data Source)

This data source can read the Role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_roles" "example" {
  id = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `api_permissions` (Map of String) API id with its access level: `R` read, `W` write, `D` delete. The ids are listed by the `crosswork_role_catalog` data source
- `name` (String) Role name
- `task_permissions` (Set of String) Task ids the role may use. The ids are listed by the `crosswork_role_catalog` data source
